fields.value: FreshGNN reports 3.4x up to 20.5x training speedup on ogbn-papers100M and MAG240M. It also reports a 59% reduction in memory access, with less than 1% influence on test accuracy.
Baselines and hardware for the reported speedups are not specified in the abstract.
